underdeveloped.en: The report compares transport access in underdeveloped and highly developed regions.
underdeveloped.zh: 報告比較發展較不足與高度發展地區的交通可及性。

understandable.en: Her explanation was clear and understandable even to new students.
understandable.zh: 她的說明很清楚，即使新生也容易理解。

underwrite.en: Several organizations agreed to underwrite the cost of the public exhibition.
underwrite.zh: 數個組織同意資助這場公共展覽的費用。

undesirable.en: The experiment produced an undesirable change in the material's texture.
undesirable.zh: 實驗造成材料質地出現不理想的變化。

undue.en: The teacher wanted to avoid undue pressure before the final presentation.
undue.zh: 老師希望避免在期末發表前造成過度壓力。

unemployed.en: The survey included employed, self-employed, and unemployed adults.
unemployed.zh: 這份調查納入受僱、自僱與失業的成年人。

unexpectedly.en: The weather unexpectedly improved just before the outdoor event began.
unexpectedly.zh: 戶外活動開始前，天氣出乎意料地轉好。

unfair.en: Students discussed why the rule seemed unfair to some classmates.
unfair.zh: 學生討論為什麼這項規定對部分同學似乎不公平。

unforgettable.en: The class trip became an unforgettable part of the school year.
unforgettable.zh: 這次班遊成為學年中令人難忘的一部分。

unfortunate.en: An unfortunate delay caused the concert to start twenty minutes late.
unfortunate.zh: 一場不幸的延誤讓音樂會晚了二十分鐘開始。

ungrateful.en: The character appears ungrateful at first but later apologizes sincerely.
ungrateful.zh: 這個角色一開始顯得不知感恩，但後來真誠道歉。

unlike.en: Unlike the first sample, the second remained stable in warm conditions.
unlike.zh: 不同於第一個樣本，第二個在溫暖環境中仍保持穩定。

unlimited.en: The plan does not provide unlimited storage for every user.
unlimited.zh: 這項方案並未為每位使用者提供無限儲存空間。

unload.en: Workers began to unload boxes after the delivery truck arrived.
unload.zh: 貨車抵達後，工作人員開始卸下箱子。

unofficial.en: An unofficial schedule circulated before the school released the final version.
unofficial.zh: 學校發布最終版本前，曾流傳一份非正式時程。

unpleasant.en: A strong odor made the small room unpleasant to enter.
unpleasant.zh: 強烈氣味讓那個小房間令人不太舒服。

unpredictable.en: Mountain weather can be unpredictable even during the warmer months.
unpredictable.zh: 即使在較暖的月份，山區天氣也可能難以預測。

unrest.en: The history chapter examines how economic hardship contributed to social unrest.
unrest.zh: 歷史章節探討經濟困難如何促成社會動盪。

untouched.en: One section of the old wall remained untouched during restoration.
untouched.zh: 修復期間，老牆有一部分保持原狀。

unusually.en: The library was unusually quiet on the afternoon before the holiday.
unusually.zh: 假日前一天下午，圖書館異常安靜。

upbringing.en: The biography describes how her upbringing influenced her later career.
upbringing.zh: 傳記描述她的成長背景如何影響後來的職涯。

upend.en: A sudden discovery can upend an earlier scientific explanation.
upend.zh: 突如其來的發現可能推翻先前的科學解釋。

uplift.en: The community project aims to uplift local arts and small businesses.
uplift.zh: 這項社區計畫旨在振興地方藝術與小型商家。

uproot.en: Strong winds can uproot shallow trees during severe storms.
uproot.zh: 強風可能在嚴重暴風雨中連根拔起根系較淺的樹。

usefulness.en: The survey measured the usefulness of several online study tools.
usefulness.zh: 調查衡量數種線上學習工具的實用性。

useless.en: The broken cable was useless until the damaged connector was replaced.
useless.zh: 損壞的接頭更換前，那條線材完全無法使用。

utmost.en: The laboratory treats student safety as a matter of utmost importance.
utmost.zh: 實驗室把學生安全視為最重要的事項。

utopia.en: The novel presents a utopia that gradually reveals unexpected problems.
utopia.zh: 這本小說描寫一個烏托邦，之後逐漸揭露意想不到的問題。

utterly.en: The final result was utterly different from our original prediction.
utterly.zh: 最終結果和我們原本的預測完全不同。

vaguely.en: I vaguely remember the building from a visit many years ago.
vaguely.zh: 我模糊記得多年前參觀過那棟建築。

vent.en: Warm air escaped through a vent near the classroom ceiling.
vent.zh: 暖空氣從教室天花板附近的通風口排出。

venus.en: The astronomy lesson compares venus with Earth in size and atmosphere.
venus.zh: 天文課比較金星與地球在大小和大氣方面的差異。

verb.en: Every complete sentence in this exercise needs at least one verb.
verb.zh: 這份練習中的每個完整句子都至少需要一個動詞。

vex.en: Repeated technical errors continued to vex the project team.
vex.zh: 反覆出現的技術錯誤持續困擾專題團隊。

victimize.en: School rules should never allow students to victimize classmates through bullying.
victimize.zh: 校規不應允許學生透過霸凌傷害同學。

vigorously.en: Researchers vigorously debated the interpretation of the new evidence.
vigorously.zh: 研究人員熱烈辯論新證據的解讀方式。

virtually.en: The two graphs are virtually identical except for one small difference.
virtually.zh: 除了一个小差異外，兩張圖幾乎完全相同。

virtuous.en: The story presents a virtuous leader who values fairness and honesty.
virtuous.zh: 故事描寫一位重視公平與誠實的有德領袖。

visualize.en: The diagram helps students visualize how the planets move through space.
visualize.zh: 這張圖幫助學生想像行星如何在太空中運行。

vogue.en: Minimalist design came into vogue among many technology companies.
vogue.zh: 極簡設計一度在許多科技公司中流行起來。

meaningless.en: The numbers are meaningless unless we explain what each one represents.
meaningless.zh: 如果不解釋每個數字代表什麼，這些數字就沒有意義。

mechanics.en: The physics course introduces basic mechanics through simple classroom experiments.
mechanics.zh: 物理課透過簡單課堂實驗介紹基礎力學。

meek.en: The novel's meek character gradually becomes more confident in speaking up.
meek.zh: 小說中溫順的角色逐漸更有自信表達意見。

mellow.en: The music became mellow as the performance moved toward its ending.
mellow.zh: 表演接近尾聲時，音樂變得柔和。

memo.en: The principal sent a short memo about the updated school schedule.
memo.zh: 校長寄出一份關於更新校務時程的簡短備忘錄。

menace.en: Plastic waste is a serious menace to many marine ecosystems.
menace.zh: 塑膠垃圾對許多海洋生態系構成嚴重威脅。

mentally.en: The puzzle was mentally challenging but enjoyable for most students.
mentally.zh: 這道謎題在思考上很有挑戰性，但多數學生覺得有趣。

metaphysical.en: The philosophy class discussed a metaphysical question about reality and existence.
metaphysical.zh: 哲學課討論一個關於現實與存在的形上學問題。

mileage.en: The report compares fuel use and mileage across several vehicle models.
mileage.zh: 報告比較數款車型的燃油使用與里程表現。

milligram.en: A milligram is one thousandth of a gram in the metric system.
milligram.zh: 在公制中，一毫克等於千分之一公克。
